• Show your eTicket while onboard, including multi-ride and monthly passes - no need to print
• Purchase one-way, roundtrip, multi-ride and monthly tickets with dollars or Amtrak Guest Rewards points
• Check train status
• Find station information
• Edit and manage your account profile
• Save credit cards for quick checkout
• Send your eTicket to Apple Wallet
• And so much more...

With the Amtrak app, you can do it all right from your smart device.

Discover how easy it is to fly with Viva Aerobus. With a new and improved user experience with a friendlier design, you have everything you need from wherever you are. Our Viva flight app will become your favorite travel companion. 

- View your itinerary in one place and manage multiple reservations. 

- Customize your app. Set up your profile and add your travel documents, payment methods, and companion details to speed up your check-in and future bookings. 

- Check your flight status and updates in real-time. 

-Avoid lines at the airport and check-in directly on our app quickly and easily with just one click. 

- Access your boarding pass directly from the app, even without an internet connection, or add them to your Apple Wallet and have access whenever and wherever you need them.

- Discover the best promos and start enjoying your favorite destinations. 

Download the app now and start enjoying the benefits!
